Mock Maple Syrup
By: Kevin Tu
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




1 cup Brown sugar
1 teaspoon Butter
1 cup Boiling water
1/2 teaspoon Vanilla
1/2 cup Sugar, (ie: white sugar)

Preparation

1 Makes: About 1 1/4 Cups. 2 1. Combine brown sugar and water and bring to a boil. 3 2. Caramelize whte sugar by heating it in a frying pan until sugar melts and turns brown. 4 3. Add brown sugar syrup from step 1; simmer until smooth and thick. 5 4. Pour into a pitcher containing butter and vanilla.
